success.description: You fall asleep, a sleep so deep and profound that you will appear dead to all but the most careful observer (any checks to determine whether you're alive are opposed by your Invocation). When the blessing recharges you may choose to wake up, or to continue sleeping until a later time. When you wake up, make a Recovery check as if you've slept for a night
As above, and recover all fatigue and all stress

conservative.requirements: 6 favour, must perform the prepare manoeuvre ...and get your body into a safe place! All: The sleep granted by this blessing counts as normal sleep for effects (such as a Morr blessing that is invoked when going to sleep) that reference it. A priest may invoke this blessing and 1 other blessing that keys off of sleep at the same time
